download.signupInApp: Winnditor e app oo, winndit yeeyirde hannde ko adii a udda.
download.heroTitle: Binndol ngol woni e hakkille maa, jooni e telefoŋ maa.
download.heroCopy: Yeeyirɗe, njulaagu, e inɗe yimɓe ɓe ngalaa yoɓde ma haa jooni. Ɗum tagaa ko ngam ñalawma luumo, wonaa ngam biro.
download.finalWorking: Aɗa waɗa golle tedduɗe ɗen eɗen.
download.finalTitle: Waɗ njulaagu maa e telefoŋ maa ko adii ñalawma goɗɗo majja.
download.finalCopy: Aawto TIJAR. Winndit yeeyirde, kuutorgol, e ngal ko adii a udda butel maa.
download.getAppProfile: Heɓ app oo ngam sosde profil maa
download.dashboardAltIos: Tablo TIJAR iOS holliroowo yeeyirde, kuutorɗe e njulaagu

home.heroTitle: A golli hannde. Aɗa anndi haa jooni so a heɓii nafoore.
home.heroDesc: TIJAR ko ngam njulaagu tokoosi tan — soodooɓe luumo, yeeyooɓe nyaamdu, taƴooɓe, mekanik en, e butelaaji tokoosi. Winndit yeeyirde ko adii a yejjita, yiy mo ngalaa yoɓde ma, accu jeyɗo goɗɗo yiy ma.
home.audience.title: So aɗa yeeya e juuɗe maa, ɗum tagaama ngam maa.
home.audience.copy: TIJAR wonaa ngam kala sosiyete. Ko ngam neɗɗo udditoowo ettawal, taabal walla butel tokoosi, ƴetta kaalis, yaha galle haa anndaa nafoore.
home.audience.for.traders: Soodooɓe luumo e yeeyooɓe geɗe tokoosi
home.audience.for.food: Yeeyooɓe nyaamdu, defooɓe, e defirɗe e laawol
home.audience.for.mechanics: Mekanik en, soudur en, e moƴƴinooɓe telefoŋ
home.audience.for.shops: Gollotooɓe juuɗe e butelaaji tokoosi e nder wuro
home.problem.title: Golle heewɗe wonaa nafoore.
home.problem.copy: A anndi yimɓe ɓe. A anndaa limɗe ɗe. Jeyɗo wi'a o yoɓat jaango, jaango ndee winnditaaka tawo. Neɗɗo ɗaɓɓa taƴoowo, defoowo walla mekanik, o yiya neɗɗo goɗɗo, sabu njulaagu maa ngalaa innde jaɓeteende. Kaalis oo ina yaha e juuɗe maa. O yaltata sabu alaa ko jogii ɗum.
home.problemCards.noRecords.title: Ngal ngal ina woni e hakkille maa
home.problemCards.noRecords.copy: So a waawaa wi'de mo ñamli ma e no foti, kaalis oo majjii eɗen. Deftere nde a udditataa wonaa binndol.
home.problemCards.noDigitalPresence.titl: Jeyɗo garoowo o yaha yeeso maa
home.problemCards.noDigitalPresence.copy: Yimɓe naamna sehil, caggal ɓe ƴeewa telefoŋ. So ettawal maa, defirde maa walla atelier maa alaa ɗoon, ɓe cooda e neɗɗo gonɗo ɗoon.
home.problemCards.limitedOpportunities.t: Alaa mo waawi hollude aɗa woodi goonga
home.problemCards.limitedOpportunities.c: Sellinoowo geɗe ina yiɗi soodgol mawngol. Jeyɗo ina yiɗi yoɓde ko adii o arde. So ɓe ngalaa innde nde ɓe koolkotoo, ɓe cuɓoto neɗɗo goɗɗo.
home.features.title: Geɗe nayi ɗe njulaagu maa ngalaa hannde.
home.features.record.title: Jog kaalis hannde oo
home.features.record.copy: Winndit kala yeeyirde e kuutorgol ko adii a udda. Ndeen a yiyata so ñalawma oo yoɓii ma.
home.features.understand.title: Yiy mo ngalaa yoɓde ma
home.features.understand.copy: Innde e limoore. Ngam 'mi yoɓat ma' waasa waɗde dokkal.
home.features.learn.title: Udd majjere ndee e hojomaaji seeɗa
home.features.learn.copy: Janngirɗe juutɗe e ɗemngal maa dow coggu, geɗe jogaaɗe, e ngal. Ngam butel, wonaa ngam ekkol.
home.features.verified.title: Hokku njulaagu maa innde nde yimɓe koolkotoo
home.features.verified.copy: Caggal jaɓgol, jeyaaɓe e sellinooɓe geɗe njiyata njulaagu goonga — wonaa ettawal tan.
home.learnSection.eyebrow: Janngirde wootere waawi yoɓde hoore mum
home.learnSection.title: Aɗa naamnii ekkol. Aɗa naamnii anndude coggu maa.
home.learnSection.copy: Njulaagu tokoosi heewngu majjata kaalis e geɗel ngel ɓe yeeyata ɓuri, sabu coggu nguu ko miijo. Janngirde juutnde wootere holla ŋakkeende ndee. A huutora ɗum e ñalawma oo tan.
home.visibility.title: Jeyɗo maa ɓurɗo moƴƴude o haalii sehil makko eɗen. Sehil oo waawaano yiyde ma.
home.visibility.copy: Caggal jaɓgol e app oo, TIJAR hokkata njulaagu maa profil yimɓe fof: ko a yeeyata, ɗo a woni, e no a heɓirtee. Luumo anndii ma eɗen. Jeyɗo garoowo anndaa ma.
home.howItWorks.title: Laabi tati. Ndeen a yiyata kaalis oo.
home.howItWorks.level1.label: Laawol 1
home.howItWorks.level1.title: Inndu njulaagu nguu
home.howItWorks.level1.copy: Aawto app oo. Wi' ko a yeeyata e ɗo a gollotoo.
home.howItWorks.level2.label: Laawol 2
home.howItWorks.level2.title: Winndit ñalawma oo
home.howItWorks.level2.copy: Winndit yeeyirde, kuutorgol, e ngal ko adii a yejjita.
home.howItWorks.level3.label: Laawol 3
home.howItWorks.level3.title: Accu yimɓe njiy ma
home.howItWorks.level3.copy: Jaɓee, caggal lollin profil mo jeyɗo keso koolkiɗo.
home.businesses.title: So noon a heɓirta nguurndam, aɗa naamnii TIJAR.
home.languages.title: E ɗemngal ngal a yeeyirta e mum.
home.languages.copy: Binndi e janngirɗe e Engele, Hawsa, Arab, Yoruba, Igbo, e Kiswahili. Engele biro naamnaaka.
home.languages.morePlanned: Ɗemɗe Afrik goɗɗe ina njogori arde.
home.scenes.label: Njulaagu tokoosi e Niiseeriya
home.scenes.marketAlt: Soodoowo ina yuɓɓina pimenta, tomat, e albasa e ettawal luumo Niiseeriya
home.scenes.tailorAlt: Taƴoowo ina ƴoƴa wutte e nder butel tokoosi Niiseeriya
home.scenes.foodAlt: Defoowo ina waɗa maaro jollof e liɗɗi e defirde e laawol Niiseeriya
gamification.questIntro: Ɗee ko golle ɗe joom njulaagu tokoosi waɗata e app oo. Taañu wootere. Ɗum ko aada jogaade kaalis hannde oo.
gamification.quests.record.title: Winndit yeeyirɗe hannde
gamification.quests.record.copy: Ko adii a udda, winndit ko naati e ko yalti.
gamification.quests.learn.title: Ƴeew coggu maa
gamification.quests.learn.copy: Naamnde juutnde wootere ummoraade e nguurndam luumo goonga. Yiy yeeyirde nde yoɓaani ma.
gamification.quests.understand.title: Inndu ñamaale ɗe
gamification.quests.understand.copy: Yiy nafoore, kuutorɗe, e kala mo ngalaa yoɓde ma.
gamification.quests.verify.title: Waɗa a yiyee
gamification.quests.verify.copy: Jaɓ njulaagu nguu ngam jeyɗo garoowo koolkoo innde ndee.
gamification.quizQuestion: A soodi geɗe ₦5,000 a yeeyi ɗe ₦6,500. Nafoore maa ko jelu?
gamification.quizCorrect: A jaabii goonga! A heɓatno +10 XP e app oo.
gamification.quizWrong: Jaabawol ngol ko ₦1,500 — nafoore ko coggu yeeyirde accita coggu soodgol.
pages.about.heroTitle: Tagaa ngam njulaagu ñalawma e mbaawka mawka.
pages.about.heroCopy: TIJAR ko lowre dijital ngam soodooɓe luumo, yeeyooɓe nyaamdu, taƴooɓe, gollotooɓe juuɗe, yeeyooɓe tokoosi, mekanik en e butelaaji tokoosi jogiiɗi renndo ngoo.
pages.about.introTitle: Kuutorgal weeɓngal. Anndude laaɓnde. Innde ɓurnde semmbe.
pages.about.introCopy: Joom njulaagu heewɓe ina ngolla golle tedduɗe eɗen. TIJAR ina tagee ngam weeɓnude laabi garooji ɗii faamde e ƴettude.
pages.about.values.human.title: Neɗɗaagu
pages.about.values.human.copy: Yuɓɓinaa dow joom njulaagu goonga e golle ñalawma anndaɗe.
pages.about.values.clear.title: Laaɓnde
pages.about.values.clear.copy: Konngi weeɓɗi, cuɓe yiyeeɗe e kabaruuji nafiiɗi tawa alaa konngi saɗɗi.
pages.about.values.visible.title: Yiyee
pages.about.values.visible.copy: Laawol ummoraade e golle ñalawma faade e innde jaɓeteende nde jeyaaɓe mbaawi yiyde.
pages.about.philosophyCopy: Anndude njulaagu ina foti heɓee. Winndit njulaagu ina foti weeɓde. Kala njulaagu goonga ina foti heɓde fartaŋŋe yiyeede.
pages.learn.heroTitle: Janngirɗe njulaagu waɗaaɗe ngam nguurndam goonga.
pages.learn.heroCopy: Janngu mbaawka nafiiɗo e hojomaaji, e naamne weeɓɗe e ngonka anndaaka.
pages.learn.introTitle: Janngu njulaagu no a janngirta ɗemngal.
pages.learn.introCopy: Seeɗa ñalawma kala waawi ɓeydude koolkare. Janngirɗe ko juutɗe, yiyeeɗe, e dow cuɓe ɗe joom njulaagu waɗata ñalawma kala.
pages.learn.traits.short.title: Juutnde
pages.learn.traits.simple.title: Weeɓnde
pages.learn.traits.practical.title: Nafiiɗo
pages.learn.traits.practical.copy: Huutor ko a janngi e njulaagu maa.
pages.learn.closingCopy: Janngu TIJAR ina yuɓɓinee dow cuɓe njulaagu ñalawma, wonaa miijo saɗngo.
pages.howItWorks.heroTitle: Laawol weeɓngol gootol ngam njulaagu ɓurngu semmbe.
pages.howItWorks.heroCopy: TIJAR fuɗɗoto ko e ko waɗata e njulaagu maa ñalawma kala, caggal wallu ɗum waɗde anndude, innde e yiyeede.
pages.howItWorks.steps.create.title: Sos njulaagu maa
pages.howItWorks.steps.create.copy: Haal TIJAR ko a waɗata, ɗo a gollotoo e no jeyaaɓe mbaawi heɓde ma.
pages.howItWorks.steps.recordLearn.title: Winndit e janngu
pages.howItWorks.steps.recordLearn.copy: Jog binndi njulaagu weeɓɗi e janngu mbaawka nafiiɗo e hojomaaji seeɗa.
pages.howItWorks.steps.verify.title: Jaɓee e mawnu
pages.howItWorks.steps.verify.copy: Sos innde dijital jaɓeteende, waɗa weeɓde ngam jeyaaɓe yiyde ma.
pages.howItWorks.journeyTitle: Kala golle waawi wallude njulaagu maa yahde yeeso.
pages.businessVisibility.heroTitle: Butel maa waawi wonde e wuro. Njulaagu maa waawi yiyeede kala ɗo.
pages.businessVisibility.heroCopy: Profil TIJAR moƴƴo wallata jeyaaɓe faamde ko a yeeyata, ɗo ɓe njiyata ma e no ɓe kaaldata e maa.
pages.businessVisibility.introCopy: Caggal jaɓgol, TIJAR waawi sosde profil laaɓɗo ngam njulaagu maa. O hawrina innde maa, nokku, geɗe e laabi jokkindirde e nokku weeɓɗo gooto.
pages.businessVisibility.features.verifi: Hollu jeyaaɓe wonde kabaruuji njulaagu maa ƴeewtaama.
pages.businessVisibility.features.find.c: Hokku yimɓe nokku laaɓɗo gooto ngam yiyde nokku maa e kabaruuji njulaagu.
Lollin profil njulaagu moƴƴo so jeyaaɓe naamnii ko a waɗata.
pages.businessVisibility.disclaimer: TIJAR foddaaki darnde e daɓɓugol walla jeyaaɓe tabitiiɓe.
pages.contact.heroCopy: Aɗa jogii naamne dow TIJAR walla aɗa yiɗi gollodaade? Neldu ɓataake juutɗo.
pages.privacy.title: Laawol Sirri
pages.privacy.sections.approach.title: Laawol amen
pages.privacy.sections.approach.body: TIJAR ina tagee ngam wallude njulaagu ñalawma janngude, jogaade binndi e sosde innde dijital. Min njogori mooftude tan kabaruuji naamnaaɗi ngam hokkude ɗee golle.
pages.privacy.sections.information.title: Kabaruuji ɗi a hokkay
pages.privacy.sections.information.body: So TIJAR fuɗɗiima, ɗum waawi hawrude e innde maa, kabaruuji jokkindirde, kabaruuji njulaagu, binndi njulaagu, kabaruuji jaɓgol e kabaruuji ɗi a cuɓii ɓeydude e profil njulaagu yimɓe fof.
pages.privacy.sections.usage.title: No kabaruuji huutortee
pages.privacy.sections.usage.body: Kabaruuji mbaawi huutoreede ngam hokkude golle TIJAR, moƴƴinde geɗel ngel, wallude jaɓgol, reende konte, kaaldigal e huutorɓe e timminde sarɗi sariya.
pages.privacy.sections.publicProfiles.bo: Tan kabaruuji peewnaaɗi ngam profil njulaagu poti waɗeede yimɓe fof. Joom njulaagu ina foti waawde faamde kabaruuji ɗi ngoni yimɓe fof ko adii ɓe njaltina ɗum.
pages.privacy.sections.choices.title: Cuɓe maa
pages.privacy.sections.choices.body: Aɗa foti waawde ƴeewde, moƴƴinde walla naamnaade momtugol kabaruuji maa potɗi. Laabi jokkindirde ɓeydete ko adii TIJAR fuɗɗa mooftude kabaruuji e oo lowre.
pages.privacy.sections.preview.title: Oo misal
pages.privacy.sections.preview.body: Forme ɗe e oo misal lowre neldataa walla jogaaki kabaruuji neɗɗo. Oo laawol ɓeydete ko adii mooftugol kabaruuji goonga fuɗɗa.
pages.terms.title: Sarɗiiji
pages.terms.sections.preview.title: Misal lowre
pages.terms.sections.preview.body: Oo lowre sifoto TIJAR e laawol maggo jogorngol. Ekran geɗe, janngirɗe e profil njulaagu holliraaɗi ɗo ko misaaluuji, mbaawi waylude ko adii ɓe njaltine.
TIJAR holliraaka no ñamloowo, app ñamaande walla suudu kaalis. Alaa ko e oo lowre fodii kaalis, ɓeydagol jeyaaɓe walla darnde e daɓɓugol.
pages.terms.sections.acceptableUse.title: Huutorgol jaɓaangol
pages.terms.sections.acceptableUse.body: Waa etto saɗtinde lowre ndee, huutor forme maggo no moƴƴaani, walla huutor loowdi maggo e laawol luutndii sariya walla hakke neɗɗo goɗɗo.
pages.terms.sections.information.title: Kabaruuji e woodgol
pages.terms.sections.information.body: Min njogori jogaade kabaruuji laaɓɗi e goonga, kono geɗe sifaaɗe ɗo mbaawataa woodde haa jooni. Golle Aawto TIJAR maantiniri ko ɗo ɓooyaani.
pages.terms.sections.changes.title: Waylooji
pages.terms.sections.changes.body: Ɗee sarɗi mbaawi hesɗitineede no TIJAR mawni. Sarɗi golle timmuɗi e kabaruuji jokkindirde kokkete ko adii lowre ndee fuɗɗa huutoreede e huutorɓe.
forms.contact.name: Innde Timmiinde
forms.contact.disclaimer: Oo misal neldataa walla jogaaki ɓataakeji haa jooni.
forms.contact.successCopy: A jarama ngam heɓde amen. Oo misal lowre neldataa ɓataakeji haa jooni.
forms.contact.errors.name: Tiiɗno winndu innde maa.

auth.registerWelcomeBody: Sos konte maa, ƴettu laawol adanol faade e njulaagu ɓurngu faamde, yuɓɓinde e yiyeede.
auth.securityFooter: Kabaruuji maa ina kuudi e TIJAR
auth.googleSoon: Seŋagol Google woodat so ɗum yuɓɓinaama.
auth.phoneLoginSoon: Seŋagol telefoŋ naamnii yuɓɓingol SMS. Tiiɗno huutor email maa jooni.
auth.publicLoginLead: Seŋo ngam udditde tablo njulaagu maa — yeeyirɗe, geɗe jogaaɗe, jeyiɗo, e Janngu.
auth.accessDesc: Huutor email e konngol sirri TIJAR maa. A keso ɗo?
auth.webRegisterHero: Fuɗɗo ko mehre — mawnu e laaɓal
auth.webBrandBody: Winndit yeeyirɗe, reen geɗe jogaaɗe, yuɓɓin jeyiɗo, janngu no a yahata. Tagaa ngam soodooɓe luumo, butelaaji, e kippuuji tokoosi.
auth.webBullet1: Kabaruuji yeeyirɗe e kuutorɗe e sahaa goonga

auth.webBullet3: Janngu Kuuɗe Njulaagu no a yuɓɓinta butel maa

auth.webRegisterSubtitle: Ɗum ƴettat hojom gooto. Ndeen min mballat ma yuɓɓinde profil njulaagu maa.
auth.deployEnvHint: Oo server mahaa tawa alaa kabaruuji Supabase. Ɓeydu geɗe ɗe les ɗo e tablo hosting maa, caggal mah kadi lollin.
app.onboarding.supplierCreditTitle: Aɗa sooda e sellinooɓe geɗe e ngal?
app.sales.hubHint: Kala yeeyirde nde a winnditi hesɗitinta nafoore, geɗe jogaaɗe, e golle Janngu maa.
app.sales.newSaleSubtitle: Winndu limoore e no jeyịɗo yoɓri.
app.sales.amountHint: Winndu kaalis mo a heɓi e yeeyirde ndee.
app.sales.customerOptional: Suɓaade — accu mehre ngam jeyịɗo laawol.
app.sales.productHint: Cuɓu e geɗe maa — geɗe jogaaɗe e nafoore hesɗitintee e hoore mum.
app.sales.noProducts: Ɓeydu geɗe adii ngam kala yeeyirde ƴeew nafoore.
app.products.comingSoon: Limto geɗe e rewde geɗe jogaaɗe ngarat e sahaa garoowo.
app.products.addSubtitle: Inndu ɗum, waɗ cogguuji, lim ko a jogii hannde.
app.products.inventoryHint: Dogginaa e coggu soodgol × limoore jogaaɗo.
app.products.adjustSubtitle: Winndit geɗe naatii walla njaltii e sabaabu.
app.products.pickProduct: Cuɓu geɗel e limto ngoo adii.
app.products.adjustDirectionHint: Naata = a heɓi geɗe. Yalta = yeeyaama walla majjii.
app.products.pricingHint: Wallata nafoore e nafooje geɗe jogaaɗe.
app.products.stockHint: Limtol fuɗɗorde e sahaa mo a humpata.
app.products.notesHint: Etaaje, sellinoowo geɗe, walla mawngu pakii.
app.products.pricingHintFull: Ko a yoɓata faadti e ko a naamnitta — TIJAR holla nafoore e kala yeeyirde.
app.products.serviceCostHint: Ko ɗum ƴettata e maa ngam hokkude kuugal faadti e ko jeyịɗo yoɓata.
app.expenses.hubHint: Kala kuutorgol ngol a winnditi jogata nafoore goonga, hokka semmbe golle Janngu.
app.expenses.newExpenseSubtitle: Winndu limoore e no a yoɓri.
app.expenses.amountHint: Winndu kaalis yaltiijo e njulaagu maa.
app.expenses.categoryHint: Taañu yaaw — a waawi ɓeydude kabaruuji les ɗo.
app.health.title: Cellal njulaagu
app.health.subtitle: Dogginaa e binndi maa ñalɗi 30 ɗen cakkitiiɗi e ngal.
app.health.noRecommendations: Yiyoo no moƴƴi — jokku winnditde yeeyirɗe e kuutorɗe.
app.health.reco.collectCreditBody: Yimɓe ina ngalaa yoɓde ma haa jooni. Jokkondir walla winndit yoɓdi so ɓe yoɓii.
app.health.reco.creditRatioTitle: Ngal ina teddi faadti e yeeyirɗe
app.health.reco.creditRatioBody: Feccere mawnde e yeeyirɗe cakkitiiɗe ko ngal. Moofon ko adii a hokka ngal goɗngal.
app.health.reco.reviewExpensesBody: Kuutorgol ɓurii kaalis naatiiɗo e leeu nduu. Ƴeew cogguuji maa ɓurɗi mawde.
app.health.reco.recordMoreBody: Defte maa ina keewi seeɗa. Hay yeeyirɗe e kuutorɗe tokoose wallata ma yiyde nafoore.
app.health.reco.supplierPayBody: Aɗa jogii yoɓde sellinooɓe geɗe. Yuɓɓin yoɓdi ngam geɗe jokku arde.
app.health.reco.profitHealthyBody: Yeeyirɗe ina yeeso cogguuji. Jog aada winnditde ñalawma kala noon.
app.records.title: Jaltin & naatnu

app.learn.bb.l1.title: Aɗa heɓa kaalis goonga?
app.learn.bb.l1.story1: Aisha ina jogii butel wutteeji tokoosi. Hannde o yeeyi ₦50,000 o yahi galle e weltaare.
app.learn.bb.l1.story3: Yeeyirɗe ina nanndi e nafoore — kono ko gootum e nafoore?
app.learn.bb.l1.chooseExplain: Yeeyirɗe wonaa gootum e nafoore. So o huutori ₦35,000 e geɗe jogaaɗe, nafoore mawnde ko ₦15,000 (₦50,000 − ₦35,000).
app.learn.bb.l1.mathInsight: Nafoore mawnde e yeeyirde = kaalis naatiiɗo − ko yeeyirde ndee ƴetti e maa.
app.learn.bb.l1.calcQ: A yeeya ₦10,000. Ɗum ƴetti e maa ₦7,000. Nafoore maa mawnde ko jelu?
app.learn.bb.l2.title: Yeeyirɗe ≠ nafoore
app.learn.bb.l2.salesQ: Limoore nde holli jelu a yeeyi?
app.learn.bb.l2.salesExplain: Yeeyirɗe ko kaalis mo jeyaaɓe yoɓi ma — ko adii cogguuji.
app.learn.bb.l2.profitQ: Limoore nde holli ko heddii caggal cogguuji?
app.learn.bb.l2.profitExplain: Nafoore ko ko heddii caggal coggu geɗel e cogguuji njulaagu goɗɗi.
app.learn.bb.l2.compareQ: Njulaagu ngu heɓi nafoore ɓurnde mawndu?
app.learn.bb.l3.title: Deftere maa ko siftorɗe njulaagu maa
app.learn.bb.l3.story1: Musa yuɓɓini butel mum duuɓi tati.
app.learn.bb.l3.story2: Neɗɗo naamnii: “Jelu a heɓi leeu ɗayii?”
app.learn.bb.l3.story4: Siftorɗe maa wonaa laawol limtugol kaalis.
app.learn.bb.l3.insight: Joom njulaagu binndooɓe geɗe anndi ko waɗata goonga — wonaa ko ɓe miijii.
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseQ: Moy ɓuri waawde anndude ko waɗata e njulaagu nguu?
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseExplain: Binndi ñalawma kala ɓura siftorɗe sahaa kala.
app.learn.bb.l3.missionHint: Winndit yeeyirɗe maa 5 garooje e TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l4.title: Kala yeeyirde ina jogii haala
app.learn.bb.l4.intro: Binndol moƴƴol jaaboto: ko yeeyaama, jelu, ndey, moy, no ɓe yoɓri, e so huunde heddii e ngal.
app.learn.bb.l4.amountQ: A winnditii tan “₦25,000” — ɗum ena kasti?
app.learn.bb.l4.amountB: Alaa — binndol timmungol holla haala kaalis oo
app.learn.bb.l4.amountExplain: Limoore tan hollaani geɗel, jeyịɗo, yoɓdi, walla ngal.
app.learn.bb.l4.checklist: Ko · Jelu · Ndey · Jeyịɗo · Laawol yoɓdi · Yoɓaama timmi? · Huunde heddii e ngal?
app.learn.bb.l4.missionHint: Uddit Winndit → Yeeyirde, danndu yeeyirde goonga wootere e TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l5.title: Uddit butel maa no annduɗo
app.learn.bb.l5.routine: Udditgol hojomaaji 5: ☑ Ƴeew kaalis · ☑ Geɗe jogaaɗe nafiiɗe · ☑ Soodde hannde · ☑ Jeyaaɓe ñamliiɓe · ☑ Faandaare yeeyirɗe hannde
app.learn.bb.l5.openQ: Butel maa udditiima. Ko a waɗata adii?
app.learn.bb.l5.openB: Ƴeew ko njulaagu nguu naamnii hannde
app.learn.bb.l5.openExplain: Ƴeewgol yaawngol yuɓɓinta ma ngam yeeyde e woddde seedaaji.
app.learn.bb.l6.title: Ɗo kaalis oo yahi?
app.learn.bb.l6.story1: Aisha waɗi yeeyirɗe ₦80,000 — kono tan ₦15,000 heddii e udditgol.
app.learn.bb.l6.story2: Transport, nyaamdu, geɗe jogaaɗe, kuuraa, kuutorgol hoore, gollotooɓe… walla anndaaka?
app.learn.bb.l6.leaks: Kaalis waawi yaltude e cogguuji njulaagu, geɗe jogaaɗe, ngal, walla kuutorgol ngol winnditaaka.
app.learn.bb.l6.teach: So a winnditaaki ɗo kaalis yahata, njulaagu maa waawi majjude kaalis e deeƴre.
app.learn.bb.l6.missionHint: Winndit kuutorgol gootol e TIJAR ngam a annd ɗo kaalis yahi.
app.learn.bb.l7.title: Kaalis njulaagu ≠ kaalis hoore
app.learn.bb.l7.story1: Njulaagu Musa ina jogii ₦100,000. Sehil noddi mo o yalta.
app.learn.bb.l7.story2: O ƴetti ₦20,000 e kaalis njulaagu nguu.
app.learn.bb.l7.withdrawExplain: Ƴettude kaalis butel ngam hoore maa wonaa jaasgol e hoore mum — kono aɗa foti anndude ko ɗum woni, winndit ɗum no moƴƴi.
app.learn.bb.l7.teach: Maantin ƴettugol e kuutorɗe ngam nafoore maa jogoo goonga.
app.learn.bb.l8.title: Udd butel maa no annduɗo
app.learn.bb.l8.v2: Ko adii a udda, ƴeew ko waɗi.
app.learn.bb.l8.v3: Uddude no moƴƴi = seedaaji seeɗa jaango.
app.learn.bb.l8.closeQ: Ko a ƴeewata ko adii a udda?
app.learn.bb.l8.closeA: Yeeyirɗe, kuutorɗe, kaalis/yoɓdi, e ngal jeyịɗo
app.learn.bb.l8.closeC: Alaa huunde — jaango ko ñalawma goɗɗo
app.learn.bb.l8.closeExplain: Uddugol hojomaaji 5 jogata binndi e kaalis e goonga.
app.learn.bb.l8.closingList: Uddugol hojomaaji 5: 1) Winndit yeeyirɗe 2) Winndit kuutorɗe 3) Ƴeew kaalis/yoɓdi 4) Ƴeew ngal jeyịɗo 5) Ƴeew golle hannde
app.learn.bb.l8.missionHint: Winndit hay yeeyirde wootere hannde ngam ñalawma maa jogee e TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l9.title: Njulaagu maa ina jogii ɓernde yahri
app.learn.bb.l9.intro: Kala njulaagu ina jogii limɗe seeɗa ɗe a foti anndude — tawa alaa konngi limtugol saɗɗi.
app.learn.bb.l9.debtQ: Limoore nde holli jeyaaɓe ina ngalaa yoɓde ma?
app.learn.bb.l9.debtExplain: Ngal jeyịɗo (ñaamde) ko kaalis mo njulaagu maa ngalaa yoɓde haa jooni.
app.learn.bb.l10.title: Joom njulaagu hojomaaji 10
app.learn.bb.l10.intro: Aɗa jogii hojomaaji 10 ko adii udditgol. Cuɓu golle joyi fajiri nafiiɗe.
app.learn.bb.l10.mBad: Accu njulaagu nguu haa jeyịɗo naata
app.learn.bb.l10.evening: Aada kiikiɗe: winndit yeeyirɗe · winndit kuutorɗe · winndit ngal · ƴeew yoɓdi · ƴeew ñalawma oo.
app.learn.bb.l10.levelComplete: Tolno timmii! A heɓii Fuɗɗoowo Njulaagu 🏆 — Annduɗo Kaalis e laabi goɗɗi udditoo no TIJAR mawni.
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1: Nafoore e yeeyirde wootere ɓuri sifeede no…
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1a: Kaalis naatiiɗo accita ko yeeyirde ndee ƴetti e maa
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1c: Tan kaalis mo a huutoraani haa jooni
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q2: So a yeeyi ₦1,000 ɗum ƴetti e maa ₦700, nafoore ko…
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3: Winnditde coggu soodgol e coggu yeeyirde wallata ma…
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3a: Yoɓde impôt ɓurɗo heewde e anniya
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3c: Yiyde geɗe ɗe ngaddata kaalis goonga
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q1: Ndey potɗaa winnditde yeeyirɗe e kuutorɗe hannde?
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q1b: Ñalawma oo tan, so aɗa siftora
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q2a: Anndude so njulaagu nguu ina dañi walla ina majja
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q1a: Kaalis ina yaha naatde e yaltude e sahaa
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2: A waawi wonde aɗa yeeya no feewi kono kaalis dara so…
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2a: Jeyaaɓe yoɓat ma ko adii jaggal maa ari
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2b: Yeeyirɗe ngal njokkata caggal jaggal maa
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2c: A winndita kala yeeyirde e ñalawma oo tan
app.learn.content.finSeparate.q1: Ɗuɗnugol kaalis hoore e butel saɗtina…
app.learn.content.finSeparate.q2a: Huutor nokku gooto ngam ƴeewde kaalis butel tan
app.learn.content.strPricing.q1: Coggu maa ina foti suddaade hay…
app.learn.content.strPricing.q1b: Coggu soodgol e no kasti ngam yoɓde ma e butel ngel
app.learn.content.strPricing.q2: Jeyaaɓe tokoosi sahaa kala teddinta no feewi…
app.learn.content.perHabits.q1: Aada ñalawma semmbingol ngam joom njulaagu ko…
app.learn.content.perHabits.q2a: Mawninde mbaawka walloo ka njulaagu maa
app.learn.content.audStock.q1a: Yiyde geɗe ŋakkuɗe e wujjugol ko yaawi
app.learn.content.audStock.q2: So limtol e etaaje lesɗii binndi maa…
app.learn.content.audStock.q2a: A waawi jogaade majjere, bonon, walla yeeyirɗe ŋe winnditaaka
app.learn.content.audStock.q2b: Aɗa foti ɓurde alɗude e hoore mum
app.learn.content.islTrade.q1b: Geɗe laaɓɗe, coggu laaɓngu, alaa fewre
app.learn.content.islTrade.q1c: Yeeyde ko a jeyaaki tawa a haalaani
app.learn.content.islTrade.q2a: Wonde nuunɗuɗo dow ko jeyịɗo heɓata
app.learn.content.islRiba.q1c: Ɓeydagol nuunɗaangol e ñamaande walla yoɓdi ɗayniiɗo
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2: Ngam ngal butel ñalawma, TIJAR wallata ma…
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2a: Ƴeew ko ngalaa yoɓde tawa alaa laabi riba suuɗaaɗi

app.profile.settings.oauthPassword: A seŋiima e Google. Yuɓɓin konngol sirri maa e konte Google maa.

app.assistant.title: Haalu e TIJAR
app.assistant.subtitle: Dannduɗo defte maa e daande
app.assistant.heroBody: Haalu ko waɗi e butik maa — yeeyirde, njulaagu, geɗe coodeteeɗe — TIJAR safrante winndere nde.
app.assistant.micHint: Wolde juutnde wootere ɓuri moƴƴude — sifaa, keewal e ko nde woni ngam mum.
app.assistant.typingWorks: Winnditaade e les ɗoo ena huuwa timmundi.
app.assistant.inputPlaceholder: Winndit e nokku mum… yeru: Winndit yeeyirde 5000 e maaro
app.assistant.nothingSaved: Alaa ko danndee haa a ƴeewta.
app.assistant.saveFailedReply: Ajarama, mi waawaano danndude ɗum. Eto kadi.
app.assistant.needBusinessReply: Timmin teelte njulaagu maa arande, caggal ɗum mi waawan ciftinde limle maa.
app.assistant.checkingReply: Accu mi ƴeewa limle maa goonga…
app.assistant.summaryUnknown: Mi faamaani keewal walla sifaa. Eto: 'Winndit yeeyirde 5000 e maaro'.
app.assistant.heroBodyFull: Haalu ngam winndude yeeyirde e njulaagu, walla uddit Yimɓe ɗiɗo ngam haalaade — konnguɗi maa mbinndee, mfirtee, kaaletee e ɗemngal cuɓuɗaa.
app.assistant.emptyBooks: Ñippu mic haalu yeeyirde walla njulaagu. Ko haaliɗaa e jaabawol TIJAR ina njiyaa ɗoo.
app.assistant.emptyChat: Neɗɗo A ena haala, Neɗɗo B ena nannda e ɗemngal mum — caggal ɗum waylu. Fof ena heddii e yeewtere ndee.
app.assistant.tapMicBooks: Ñippu mic — mi winndata ko haaliɗaa mi haalataa kadi
app.assistant.chatHint: A haalata {from} → ɓe nanndata {to} (daande tan — alaa binndol)
app.assistant.hausaVoiceOnly: Daande Hausa (haalu & heɗo) ena huuwa e telefon oo. Firo binndol Hausa naatnaaka tawo e API NKENNEAi — asliwol ena yiyee.
app.assistant.sameLanguageHint: Banceeje ɗiɗi kuutortoo ɗemngal gootal — asliwol kaaletee e daande.
app.assistant.emptyChatSpeakOnly: Timmi — ñippu Haalu, caggal ɗum Fir & haalu. A nanndata tan ɗemngal goɗngal.
app.assistant.chatHintSpeakOnly: Alaa binndol e yaynirde. Firo daande tan ena fijee.
app.assistant.speakOriginalFallback: Waawaani firde — ena haala konnguɗi maa e daande.
app.products.voiceHint: Say something like: "Rice sell 15000 cost 12000 stock 20 bag" — then check the form and Save.
app.products.voiceFilled: Form filled from your voice — check and Save.
app.products.voiceNeedName: I heard you, but need a product name. Try again.
app.products.voiceFailed: Voice failed. Type the product instead.
